Aya Endō.question: In the internet radio program _____, she formed the voice acting unit "Plume" with Manabi Mizuno and Shiho Kawaragi, but it is currently inactive
Aya Endō.fact: In the internet radio program Plume Monogatari, she formed the voice acting unit "Plume" with Manabi Mizuno and Shiho Kawaragi, but it is currently inactive.

Aya Endō.subject: Telecom & Postal
Aya Endō.question: In _____, she won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 3rd Seiyu Awards
Aya Endō.fact: In 2009, she won the Best Supporting Actress award at the 3rd Seiyu Awards.

Aya Endō.subject: Telecom & Postal
Aya Endō.question: Following the closure of Office PAC on 31 March _____, Endō become affiliated with Intention, a voice acting agency founded by voice actor Kenichi Suzumura
Aya Endō.fact: Following the closure of Office PAC on 31 March 2025, Endō become affiliated with Intention, a voice acting agency set up by voice actor Kenichi Suzumura.
